description: List works by an author. Returns titles, cover IDs, and work OLIDs for drilling into editions or details. Use openlibrary_get_author for author bio and details, or openlibrary_get_editions to explore specific printings.

author_id.description: Open Library Author ID (OL…A). A leading "/authors/" prefix is stripped if provided.

name: openlibrary_get_author_works

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: Author ID does not exist on Open Library, names a record that is not an author (a work or edition OLID), or redirects to no reachable author. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Set when the requested author ID was merged into a different canonical ID.

offset.description: Zero-based offset of the first returned result — echoes the requested offset, so an empty page still records the offset that produced it.

totalCount.description: Total works by this author across all pages.

works.description: Works by this author, up to limit.

first_publish_date.description: First publication date string. Absent when not recorded.

work_id.description: Open Library Work ID (OL…W). Use for openlibrary_get_work or openlibrary_get_editions.

title: Get Author Works
